card.name: First letter of capitalized brand names
card.fires_on: The first letter (often V or P) of an all-caps brand drug name that has been split into pieces, such as V-IBATIV, P-EGASYS, V-YVGART. It fires where a product name starts in a sentence.

modes.label: Brand name start
modes.description: A single capital letter that begins an all-caps brand name, usually as the subject or after 'with' or 'taking'.
modes.example: Embryofetal Toxicity:<< V>>IBATIV may cause fetal harm.

modes.label: Drug combination name start
modes.description: The first letter of a generic drug name in a list of antivirals.
modes.example: Hepatitis C antiviral agents: Boceprevir Elbasvir/Grazoprevir<< P>>ibrentasvir/Glecaprev

modes.label: Other word start
modes.description: Occasional word starts that are not drug names, as in 'at baseline' or 'VIGOROUSLY'.
modes.example: DO NOT SHAKE or SWIRL<< V>>IGOROUSLY. Do not remove

card.writes: It adds the rest of an unfamiliar word, such as a brand name's continuation, but the promoted tokens look mixed and unclear.
card.plain: It marks the opening letter of a brand drug name that is written in capitals and broken into pieces.
